authority: T0 exact matrix-counterterm coercive shift, abstract inductive-state compactness, matched-cut defect identity, and regularity no-go; claim-nonbearing and not an interacting continuum-QFT, Hadamard, physical-vacuum, C6, CP1, or Pre-A theorem
statement: Write the declared common-diagonal Wick interaction as :W4:_C=W4+(1/2)q^T deltaK_C q+6C^2(g+4lambda), with deltaK_C=-3C[(g+lambda)I+lambda L_Q3]. Add a fixed renormalized quadratic matrix K_R=m_R I+eta_R L_Q3. Its raw quadratic Walsh eigenvalues are kappa_s=m_R+2s eta_R-3C(g+lambda+2s lambda), s=0,1,2,3. If b_C=(1/2)max(0,-min_s kappa_s) and epsilon_C=16b_C^2/g-6C^2(g+4lambda), then V_C=(1/2)q^T K_R q+:W4:_C+epsilon_C is at least g|q|^4/64. Thus, after this declared cutoff-dependent scalar shift, the enlarged finite-regulator Hamiltonians have a cutoff-uniform lower form bound in the Riemann-sum convention and retain the standard fixed-regulator ground/Gibbs construction. For any chosen states on the nested dyadic type-I algebras, compactness of the product of state spaces gives a subnet whose every fixed-regulator restriction converges to a compatible state on the inductive C-star limit. Conjugating the natural bulk embeddings by the registered unitary fixed-regulator cut anchors constructs exact matched-reference-cut monomorphisms, and the cut-state defect equals the bulk-state defect exactly. This kinematic square cannot be promoted to exact natural interacting dynamics equivariance within the declared inserted-one-dimensional g>0 family and quadratic-counterterm class: on the collective retained-zero/added-Nyquist plane, the fine force on P_X contains -(3g/L)X*Y^2, a cubic force term quadratic in the added mode, so the low algebra is not invariant. For ground projectors, define sigma_M=iota_(M,2M,*)(P_(2M)), eta_M=1-Tr(P_M sigma_M), and d_M=||sigma_M-P_M||_1; then 2eta_M<=d_M<=2sqrt(eta_M), while exact failure at each pair does not decide whether d_M tends to zero. Abstract compactness and lower stability do not imply regularity: squeezed one-oscillator Hamiltonians h_N=[N P^2+Q^2/N]/2 have a uniform spectrum and regular normal ground states but a nonregular pointwise Weyl limit. A positive continuum-state proof needs an additional regularity mechanism, such as uniform fixed-mode characteristic equicontinuity or moment bounds, and a full-sequence claim separately needs a Cauchy, uniqueness-plus-uniformity, or equivalent identification theorem.
verdict: ADVANCE UNIFORM MATRIX-COUNTERTERM LOWER STABILITY, ABSTRACT COMPATIBLE-SUBNET EXISTENCE, AND AN EXACT MATCHED-CUT DEFECT IDENTITY; REJECT LOWER-STABILITY PLUS WEAK-STAR COMPACTNESS AS A REGULAR CONTINUUM-STATE PROOF AND REJECT EXACT NATURAL LOW-MODE INTERACTING DYNAMICS EQUIVARIANCE

matrix_counterterm_candidate.domain: g>0, lambda>=0, C>=0, real m_R and eta_R, eight Q3 species, and any finite centered spatial regulator
matrix_counterterm_candidate.scheme_boundary: this candidate Wick-orders W4 only and leaves (1/2)q^T K_R q outside the Wick operator; Wick-ordering the whole quadratic-plus-quartic polynomial would add the scalar -(C/2)Tr K_R=-4*C*m_R-12*C*eta_R and must be treated as a different declared energy convention
matrix_counterterm_candidate.raw_quadratic: K_raw(C)=K_R+deltaK_C; this sign convention is defined by (1/2)q^T K_R q+:W4:_C=W4+(1/2)q^T K_raw(C)q+6C^2(g+4lambda)

uniform_coercive_shift.quartic_SOS: sum_e q_e^4-|q|^4/8=(1/8)sum_(e<f)(q_e^2-q_f^2)^2>=0 and the Q3 quartic lock is nonnegative, so W4(q)>=g*|q|^4/32
uniform_coercive_shift.lattice_result: Hhat_(a,C)>=a*g/512*sum_j |q_j|^4>=0 after the declared scalar shift, because the kinetic and spatial-gradient forms are nonnegative
uniform_coercive_shift.state_invariance: epsilon_C is an additive scalar local energy convention and therefore does not change the normalized finite-regulator ground projector or Gibbs density
uniform_coercive_shift.moment_reduction: any normalized state family with a uniform upper bound on the shifted energy immediately has uniform Riemann-sum field-fourth, momentum-second and, for lambda>0, Q3-edge-fourth moment bounds; this package does not prove that upper bound

anisotropic_Q3_strengthening.edge_SOS: with S=|q|^2 and T=q^T L_Q3 q=sum_edges(q_e-q_f)^2, sum_edges(q_e-q_f)^2(q_e^2+q_f^2)>=T^2/24; together with sum_e q_e^4>=S^2/8 this is sharp on the Q3 bipartite Walsh ray
anisotropic_Q3_strengthening.result: with epsilon_C_aniso in place of epsilon_C, V_C(q)>=g*S^2/64+lambda*T^2/192; this preserves cutoff-uniform quartic control of both total amplitude and Q3 variation
anisotropic_Q3_strengthening.lambda_zero_boundary: for lambda=0 use the general Walsh-minimum scalar completion; a negative eta_R is then absorbed through min_s kappa_s rather than divided by lambda

finite_regulator_state.result: the uniform quartic coercive bound implies, at every fixed regulator, the same Friedrichs self-adjointness, compact resolvent, simple strictly positive ground and trace-class finite-beta Gibbs construction as the registered finite-state authority
finite_regulator_state.boundary: fixed-regulator existence and a cutoff-uniform lower form bound do not give a cutoff-uniform ground-energy upper bound, spectral gap, moments, local energy, or convergence

scalar_shift_Gaussian_trial_no_go.excluded_route: for fixed g, lambda, m_R and eta_R, use one scalar energy shift to make the local Wick polynomial pointwise uniformly lower stable and simultaneously obtain a cutoff-uniform variational upper bound from the same Wick-reference Gaussian
scalar_shift_Gaussian_trial_no_go.singlet_minimum: on q_e=x, F_C=2*g*x^4+[4*m_R-12*C*(g+lambda)]*x^2+6*C^2*(g+4*lambda); when 12*C*(g+lambda)>4*m_R its minimum is 6*C^2*(g+4*lambda)-[12*C*(g+lambda)-4*m_R]^2/(8*g)
scalar_shift_Gaussian_trial_no_go.full_Gaussian_mean: for P_C(q)=(1/2)q^T K_R q+:W4:_C(q), the full eight-component reference mean of this local quadratic-plus-Wick polynomial is mu_C=E_C[P_C]=C*(4*m_R+12*eta_R); this is not the one-variable Gaussian expectation of the singlet restriction F_C
scalar_shift_Gaussian_trial_no_go.gap: because inf_(q in R^8) P_C(q)<=min_x F_C(x), mu_C-inf_q P_C(q)>=mu_C-min_x F_C(x)=[12*g+12*lambda+18*lambda^2/g]*C^2+O(C); if inf_q(P_C+s_C)>=-B then E_C[P_C+s_C]>=mu_C-min_x F_C-B, so this same-Gaussian upper bound diverges at least as Theta((log N)^2) for C_N=Theta(log N)
scalar_shift_Gaussian_trial_no_go.not_excluded: a sharper global operator lower bound, a Nelson or spatial-kinetic cancellation, a non-Gaussian trial family, a constructive vector P(phi)_2 argument, or another fully specified normalization

ground_entanglement_distance.definitions: P_(0,M) denotes the ground projector of this Wick/matrix-counterterm family at declared C_M,K_R; sigma_M=iota_(M,2M,*)(P_(0,2M)), eta_M=1-Tr(P_(0,M) sigma_M), d_M=||sigma_M-P_(0,M)||_1, where iota_* is the predual state restriction; in a factorizing chart iota(A)=V(A tensor I)V^*, sigma_M=Tr_add(V^*P_(0,2M)V), not bare Tr_add P_(0,2M)
ground_entanglement_distance.bounds: the two-outcome effect P_M gives d_M>=2*eta_M, while Fuchs-van de Graaf for the pure P_M gives d_M<=2*sqrt(eta_M)
ground_entanglement_distance.equivalence: d_M tends to zero if and only if eta_M tends to zero
ground_entanglement_distance.known_boundary: the EXP-000764 mixed-derivative proof also gives eta_M>0 for this enlarged family because scalar and quadratic counterterms do not change the nonzero X^2Y^2 derivative; it gives no uniform positive lower bound and no decay estimate, so exact projectivity fails while asymptotic projectivity remains open

abstract_state_compactness.algebras: A_M=B(H_M) with the transitive natural low-mode monomorphisms iota_(M,N), including the reciprocal coarse-Nyquist squeeze at the one exceptional real quadrature
abstract_state_compactness.theorem: for any cofinal dyadic family of finite-regulator states omega_N, Tychonoff compactness of product_M S(A_M) gives a subnet for which omega_N composed with iota_(M,N) converges pointwise on every fixed A_M
abstract_state_compactness.compatibility: transitivity of iota makes the coordinate limits compatible and hence defines a state on the unital inductive C-star limit
abstract_state_compactness.boundary: this full-B(H_M) pointwise subnet statement and fixed-mode cylindrical full-sequence uniform convergence are incomparable: the former covers more observables but only along a subnet and pointwise, while the latter covers fewer labels but asks for a uniform full-sequence limit; the cluster object may be singular on every type-I factor, nonregular on the Weyl generators, nonunique, subnet dependent, and unrelated to local energy, dynamics, Hadamard form, or a physical state criterion

matched_cut_square.anchor_isomorphism: for matched typed data c_M=(C_M,n_M) and c_N=(C_N,n_N), theta_(M,c_M)(A)=Gamma_(M,C_M)^[n_M]* A Gamma_(M,C_M)^[n_M], using only registered unitary fixed-regulator reference-cut anchors; later Gamma_(M,C) abbreviates the full typed datum
matched_cut_square.embedding: j_(M,N,C)=theta_(N,C) composed with iota_(M,N) composed with theta_(M,C)^(-1)
matched_cut_square.defect_identity: Omega_(N,C)(j_(M,N,C)B)-Omega_(M,C)(B)=omega_N(iota_(M,N)A)-omega_M(A) for B=theta_(M,C)(A); the anchors add exactly zero state-comparison error
matched_cut_square.normal_state_norm: for normal densities the cut-state dual-norm defect equals ||iota_(M,N,*)(rho_N)-rho_M||_1 exactly, where iota_* is the predual restriction; this becomes ||Tr_add rho_N-rho_M||_1 only in the declared tensor-factor chart implementing the natural embedding, including the Nyquist-squeeze unitary
matched_cut_square.same_time_naturality: with S_M(D<-C)=Gamma_(M,D)^*Gamma_(M,C) and beta_M(B)=S_M B S_M^*, j_(M,N,D) composed with beta_M equals beta_N composed with j_(M,N,C), so every matched registered same-time re-slicing square commutes
matched_cut_square.boundary: this constructs matched same-time cut algebra squares only; it does not compare unmatched cut combinatorics, prove physical-step dynamics equivariance, or make the original finite states projective

cylindrical_topology_gate.definition: for a fixed cutoff-independent mode space V_K and label radius R, epsilon_(M,N;K,R)=sup_(F in V_K, ||F||<=R)|omega_N(W(iota_(M,N)F))-omega_M(W(F))|; fixed K eventually excludes the moving coarse Nyquist mode
cylindrical_topology_gate.Weyl_polynomial: for B=sum_l c_l W(F_l), the cut or bulk defect is at most sum_l |c_l|*epsilon(F_l); for arbitrary A in the fixed-K Weyl C-star algebra it is at most 2||A-B|| plus that polynomial bound
cylindrical_topology_gate.full_sequence: the exact Cauchy target is lim_(n->infinity) sup_(m>=n) epsilon_(n,m;K,R)=0; adjacent defects merely tending to zero are insufficient
cylindrical_topology_gate.summable_sufficient_condition: if dyadic adjacent defects obey epsilon_(n,n+1;K,R)=O(a_n^p) for some p>0, transitivity and telescoping make them summable and close the full sequence
cylindrical_topology_gate.ground_boundary: eta_M->0 is equivalent only to full retained-factor trace-norm projectivity; fixed-K cylindrical convergence can hold even when global entanglement or an orthogonality catastrophe keeps eta_M away from zero

natural_dynamics_no_go.excluded_route: for the declared inserted-one-dimensional g>0 Hamiltonians, natural low-mode embedding, and scalar-energy plus scalar/Q3-quadratic counterterm class, require exact coarse/fine Heisenberg intertwining; differentiating on the common invariant Schwartz core would require the retained fine algebra B(H_low) tensor I to be invariant
natural_dynamics_no_go.witness: on q_(j,e)=[X+(-1)^jY]/sqrt(L), the fine potential contains 3*g*X^2*Y^2/(2L), so (i/hbar)[H_f,P_X]=-partial_X U_f contains -(3*g/L)*X*Y^2 and is not retained-only
natural_dynamics_no_go.counterterm_boundary: scalar energy has zero force; scalar and Q3-Laplacian quadratic counterterms have only linear forces and the Q3 term vanishes on the collective species singlet, so none cancels X*Y^2
natural_dynamics_no_go.not_excluded: asymptotic fixed-observable dynamics, a dressed or nonnatural embedding, completely positive reduced dynamics, Hamiltonians of mean force, or a different perfect-action regulator

regularity_no_go.excluded_route: infer a regular interacting continuum state from finite-regulator normality, a uniform lower spectral bound or gap, and abstract weak-star subnet compactness alone
regularity_no_go.witness: h_N=[N*P^2+Q^2/N]/2 has spectrum n+1/2 and a regular normal squeezed ground with covariance diag(N/2,1/(2N)); its Weyl characteristic exp[-(N*u^2+v^2/N)/4] tends to zero for u!=0 and to one for u=0, discontinuously at the origin
regularity_no_go.not_excluded: regularity from uniform fixed-mode moments, characteristic equicontinuity, a constructive vector P(phi)_2 theorem, or separately proved local-energy and microlocal bounds; uniqueness or full-sequence identification is a separate gate and does not establish regularity by itself

positive_regularity_gate.sufficient_input: one sufficient mechanism is: for every fixed finite mode space V_K, a cutoff-uniform bound omega_N(R(F)^2)<=C_K*||F||^2 gives |1-omega_N(W(F))|<=sqrt(C_K)*||F|| and hence equicontinuity at the Weyl identity; this particular moment bound is not claimed necessary
positive_regularity_gate.full_sequence_input: a Cauchy theorem directly closes the uniform full-sequence target; alternatively, compactness plus uniqueness gives pointwise full-sequence convergence, and uniform equicontinuity on each fixed finite-dimensional label ball upgrades it to the displayed supremum norm
positive_regularity_gate.ground_input: for the stronger full retained-factor ground route, eta_M->0 is equivalent to trace-norm asymptotic projectivity; the weaker fixed-K cylindrical route instead needs local reduced-density or direct characteristic estimates
positive_regularity_gate.running_family_boundary: holding K_R fixed in the Wick scheme makes the raw scalar and Q3-Laplacian coefficients run like -C_N; the fixed-r classical O(a^2) and history-dynamics results are not automatically uniform for this new family

verification.fixtures: exact Q3 Walsh matrix; quartic SOS and isotropic/anisotropic square completions; rational matrix-counterterm hostile point and singlet Gaussian gap; conditional smeared-moment coefficients; pure-state entanglement-distance bounds; reciprocal Nyquist squeeze; finite-matrix same-time cut-square orientation; cylindrical telescoping; collective low/high force leakage; squeezed-oscillator regularity no-go; scope and unchanged-C6 firewalls

prior_art_boundary: Graph-Laplacian diagonalization, Wick ordering, polynomial square completion, compactness of state spaces, inductive C-star limits, Fuchs-van de Graaf inequalities, unitary conjugation of type-I factors, squeezed quasi-free states, multicomponent P(phi)_2 construction, and Osterwalder-Schrader reconstruction are established mathematics. No world-first or new general theorem is claimed. The repository-specific content is their exact composition with the CL8/Q3 counterterm convention, natural-mode embedding, registered cut anchors, and explicit proof-scope split. A Euclidean import must still prove equal-time Weyl convergence in the declared cylindrical topology; finite Euclidean time targets a beta-KMS state, infinite Euclidean time targets a ground/vacuum construction, OS reconstruction does not itself prove Lorentzian continuation or Hadamard form, and a finite-torus construction does not prove a thermodynamic phase transition.
no_overclaim: This package proves a uniform lower form bound after a declared Q3-matrix and scalar-energy counterterm convention, conditional moment reductions, fixed-regulator state existence, an abstract compatible subnet, exact matched same-time cut algebra squares and defect identities, and scoped Gaussian-trial, regularity and natural-exact-dynamics no-gos. It does not prove a uniform shifted-energy upper bound, unconditional uniform moments or local energy, interacting Weyl equicontinuity, normality or regularity of a cluster state, uniqueness or full-sequence convergence, fixed-K or full-factor asymptotic ground projectivity, asymptotic or dressed dynamics equivariance, an interacting continuum QFT or Hadamard state, the original 3D Q3 parent, a physical vacuum or below-empty-space sign, a phase transition, physical light, Lorentzian signature, time or hbar, C0 or N1-N5, C6 advancement, CP1 completion, or Pre-A completion.
